body:
Prevents illegal cross-world teleports of Display entities (Fixes Async Teleport, Chunk-Race and NMS-Fallback) - It is a fix for mostly all bossbar plugins

# 🛟🧠 DisplayTeleportGuard

Features:
- Fix for NMS Fallback
- Chunk-Race Fix
- Async Teleport Fix

This Plugin prevents cross-world teleports of Display entities (Fixes Async Teleport, Chunk-Race and NMS-Fallback)
The issue occurs because the entity isn’t properly cleaned up when players teleport using certain plugins.
My plugin safely handles the entity reinitialization, preventing orphaned boss bars, console spam, and potential performance issues — even under heavy multi-world teleport usage.

Simply its a fix for mostly all servers who are using bossbars or bossbar plugins

# **Showcase**

The player "Noisereactz" logged in and automatically received a Wither boss bar.
Normally, it gets removed when you spawn through the portal. However, if you’re using other teleport plugins, that cleanup doesn’t always happen.

That’s where my plugin comes in — it safely respawns (and properly handles) the entity, preventing console errors and ensuring performance stays stable, even when many players are teleporting between different worlds.
